description: Returns Zicron's done-for-you medical chronology service: what is delivered (case summary plus an all-provider timeline with a page citation on every entry), who it is for (plaintiff PI, med-mal and nursing-home firms, and legal nurse consultants), the published price per case and per page, first-case discount, 48-hour turnaround, scope limits (medical facts only; no standard-of-care, causation or damages opinions), security practices and how to start.
